Container.Name: itinerary-builder
Container.Overview:
Build travel itineraries card by card and export them as one self-contained HTML file: calendar-first view, tap a day for its compact cards, tap a card for full details, a printable schedule sheet, a cost summary in NT$, and every booking document (JPG/PNG/PDF) embedded so the page works offline.
Trips are stored as plain JSON plus uploaded files under /data — back that path up. Set APP_PASSWORD to require a login (any username, that password).
NOTE: this template uses an image built on the server from https://github.com/tim80732/itinerary-builder - see its README.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the editor web UI.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Trips (JSON) and uploaded documents. Back this up.

Config.Name: App Password
Config.Description: Require a login for the editor (any username, this password). Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: API Token
Config.Description: Bearer token for the JSON API at /api/v1 (for scripts and AI agents). Leave empty to turn the API off.

Config.Name: Max Upload MB
Config.Description: Largest single document upload, in MB.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone — used for the 'today' highlight in the calendar.
